import numpy as np
# hourly steps 0-24
h = np.arange(25)
# PV yield 13.5 kWh/day normal, sine 6-18h
pv_day = 13.5
pv = np.maximum(0, np.sin(np.pi*(h-6)/12))**1.2
pv = pv/pv.sum()*pv_day  # kWh per hour step approx
# electrical load 10.55 kWh/day: day pull-down heavy 7-17h, night steady 0.24kW
# build hourly load kW
load = np.full(25, 0.241)  # night steady: (203+50)/1.4/1000+0.04+0.02
# daytime add pull-down electrical: 6.25/1.4=4.46 kWh over 10h =0.446 kW extra 7-17h
for i in range(25):
    hh=h[i]
    if 7<=hh<=17:
        load[i]+=0.446
# normalize to 10.55
load = load/load.sum()*10.55
# battery sim normal day starting 80% of 10kWh usable?
usable_nom=10.0  # usable kWh chosen
soc=[6.0]
min_soc=min(soc)
for i in range(24):
    soc.append(soc[-1]+pv[i]-load[i])
    soc[-1]=min(max(soc[-1],0),usable_nom)
print(f"pv {pv.sum():.2f} load {load.sum():.2f}")
print(f"normal end {soc[-1]:.2f} min {min(soc):.2f} kWh usable {usable_nom}")
# cloudy day 30% yield
pv_c = pv*0.3
soc2=[usable_nom]  # start full
for i in range(24):
    soc2.append(soc2[-1]+pv_c[i]-load[i])
    soc2[-1]=min(max(soc2[-1],0),usable_nom)
print(f"cloudy pv {pv_c.sum():.2f} end {soc2[-1]:.2f} min {min(soc2):.2f}")
# night-only need: 18-6h load
night_load = load[18:].sum()+load[:6].sum()
print(f"night 18-6 load {night_load:.2f} kWh")
# surge: running compressor ~0.6kW elec, surge 3x ~1.8kW, inverter 2kW continuous
print("surge check done")
